title: Werewolf
short.wolf: Picks a victim with the pack at night.
short.seer: Sees one person's role every night.
short.witch: Can heal once and poison once.
short.cupid: Makes two people fall in love on the first night.
short.mayor: Elected on day one. Their vote counts double and breaks ties.
long.wolf: At night, pick a victim with your pack. By day, act innocent. You win once you are as many as everyone else.
long.villager: No special power – just your instincts. Find the werewolves and vote them out by day.
long.seer: Every night you see one person's role. Help the village, but don't reveal yourself too early – the wolves hunt you.
long.witch: At night you see who the wolves attack. Once per game you can heal (yourself too) and once poison. Both in one night is allowed.
long.hunter: When you leave – by night or by day – you immediately take someone of your choice with you.
long.cupid: On the first night you pair two people (yourself too). If one dies, the other dies of heartbreak. If it's a wolf and a villager, they only win together as the last two.
long.protector: Every night you protect one person from the wolves – yourself too, but never the same person two nights in a row.
long.mayor: The village elects a mayor on day one. Their vote counts double and breaks ties. If they die, they immediately name a successor.
when.wolf: Acts at night, in the first part.
when.villager: Taps a suspect at night (the village's gut feeling).
when.seer: Acts at night, in the first part. The result comes in the second.
when.witch: Acts at night, in the second part.
when.hunter: Acts as soon as they leave.
when.cupid: Acts only on the first night.
when.protector: Acts at night, in the first part.
intro.text: Werewolves hide in the village. At night they hunt in secret, by day you argue and send someone away. At night everyone taps their phone – so nobody gives themselves away.
intro.wolvesHow: … once they are as many as everyone else.
roles.title: Secretly check your role!
roles.text: Hold to see your card, let go to hide it. {n} werewolves are among you.
roles.phoneHint: Hold the card. Nobody should peek.
night.hintA: Everyone taps their phone. Nobody gives themselves away.
say.intro: Welcome to the village. But not everyone here is who they seem.
say.roles: The sun is setting. Secretly check your role.
say.nightA: The village sleeps. Something creeps through the alleys …|The moon is high. A wolf howls in the distance …|Fog drifts through the village. A door creaks somewhere …|The windows go dark. Only the wolves are awake …
say.nightB: A shadow darts across the rooftops …|A door quietly clicks shut …|A cauldron bubbles in the dark …
say.morning: Dawn breaks …|The rooster crows …|The sun rises …
say.morningNone: Dawn breaks. By some miracle, everyone survived.
say.hunter: {name} was the hunter and takes one last shot.
say.mayor: The village needs a mayor. Vote now.
say.discuss: Which of you is the werewolf? Discuss!
say.voteOut: The village has decided: {name} must go.
morning.lovers: Cupid joined two hearts in the night.
gut.title: The village's gut feeling
gut.text: Who the village suspected tonight. Anonymous – nobody knows who tapped whom.
lastWords.title: {name}, anything else to say?
hunter.title: {name} was the hunter!
hunter.text: One last shot – and someone comes along.
hunter.phone: Who do you take with you?
successor.title: Mayor {name} names a successor
successor.text: The office goes to someone of their choice.
mayor.title: Elect a mayor
mayor.text: Their vote counts double and breaks ties.
chronicle.title: Chronicle
chronicle.empty: Nobody has left the village yet.
discuss.title: Who is it?
discuss.arrowsHint: Arrows = suspicions from the phones. Only the vote counts.
vote.title: Who should leave the village?
vote.text: Vote on your phone. "Nobody" is allowed too.
vote.runoffText: A tie – only between these now.
vote.phone: Who should go? You can change your mind until the end.
end.wolvesText: The wolves are now as many as everyone else.
end.loversText: Wolf and villager, together to the end.
recap.title: What happened in night {n}
recap.witchSaw: {who} sees {victim} in danger … and does nothing.
recap.witchQuiet: {who} leaves the potions on the shelf.
lobby.unfair: Careful: this mix is pretty unbalanced.
lobby.hint: Everyone can read the roles on their phone · The VIP adjusts the mix
lobby.phoneWait: Tap a role to read about it. The VIP starts the night.
phone.ghost: You're out – as a ghost you guess the wolves at night.
phone.loverText: If one of you dies, so does the other. Tell nobody!
phone.lastWordsText: Tell the village something – you have 10 seconds.
phone.diedText: As a ghost you don't talk anymore, but at night you guess the wolves and collect points.
phone.ghostDay: Shh! Ghosts don't talk. At night you can guess who's a werewolf.
q.seer: Whose role do you want to see?
q.second: Who will talk the most tomorrow?
q.witch: {name} is under attack. What do you do?
